structure: A single transported population law generates independent virtual people. Source paired threshold counts determine the two marginal threshold probabilities and their joint probability. Bounded continuous marginals supply concentrations, and a Gaussian copula supplies within-category and cross-category dependence. The ferritin marginal also matches the transported geometric mean. These are population-law constraints, not forced realized sample moments. No individual source records, excluded-cohort evidence, target summaries, or empirical target weights are used.

parameter_provenance.source_suitability: USABLE for the source crude threshold association
parameter_provenance.rationale: Supplied aggregation of Table IV over folate and B12 categories. These are unadjusted joint counts, not adjusted regression estimates.
The Table I marginals agree with the Table IV aggregation. They concern the same women and are not independent evidence replications.

Transport the complete source threshold table unchanged to the phlebotomy-weighted complete-measurement target domain. No evidence identifies this transport across geography, period, parity, contraception, health exclusions, assay, or target selection.

value.lower_component: log(F)=log(15)+Z, with Z standard normal truncated to [log(0.1/15),0]
value.upper_component: log(F)=log(15)+s*Z, with Z standard normal truncated to [0,log(5000/15)/s]

parameter_provenance.rationale: Separate lower and upper log scales allow asymmetric log concentrations without deriving an implausibly restrictive single-lognormal shape from only a geometric mean and a cutoff proportion. Ferritin is raw, not inflammation-corrected. The density may change at 15, but there is no atom there.

parameter_provenance.status: ASSUMED copula family; DERIVED latent parameter and implied rank correlation
parameter_provenance.source_suitability: PARTIAL: one paired threshold probability does not identify continuous dependence
parameter_provenance.rationale: Both marginal transformations are increasing, so the Gaussian-copula rank formula applies. The source supplies neither a continuous correlation nor an adjustment set to transfer. Within-category relationships are modeled rather than treated as observed or silently set to independence.

value.sampling: Independent bivariate normal draws transformed through the fitted marginal quantiles

parameter_provenance.rationale: Bivariate normal probabilities use the integral of their derivative with respect to correlation. Calibration concerns the population law only. No sample-wide recentering, reweighting, rejection of tables, or seed selection is used.

parameter_provenance.value: Do not use the omitted Hb location, broad concentration intervals, or any adjusted, residual, multilevel, or continuous correlation.

parameter_provenance.source_suitability: UNSUITABLE or unavailable for these purposes
parameter_provenance.rationale: The Hb location is omitted because of inconsistent labeling; concentration intervals do not identify dispersion. No continuous correlation is supplied. Ferritin units follow the explicitly admitted ug/L interpretation; Hb thresholds are converted from g/L to g/dL.

requested_estimands.support_basis: The source crude table directly supports the source odds ratio. Under the explicit unchanged-table transport, the model population odds ratio is (173*1082)/(85*331), approximately 6.65. The generated-table estimate fluctuates and is not estimable if any realized cell is zero; no continuity correction is prescribed.
key_unresolved_assumptions: The source paired threshold probabilities transport to the target weighted complete-measurement domain.
Assay and plasma-versus-target measurement differences do not materially change classification at the stated raw cutoffs.
This crude association is descriptive, not a causal effect or an adjusted association.

requested_estimands.support_basis: The source joint count gives 173/1671. The same value, approximately 0.1035, is the chosen target population probability, with ordinary independent-row fluctuation in generated a/n.
key_unresolved_assumptions: The source joint prevalence transports despite source selection and target phlebotomy/complete-measurement selection.
Equal-weight generated people adequately represent the stated weighted domain under the chosen law.
No unsupported CRP restriction or inflammation correction is introduced.

requested_estimands.support_basis: Not identified by the supplied source evidence. The chosen monotone-marginal Gaussian copula implies population Spearman correlation (6/pi)*asin(rho/2), where rho is calibrated to the source paired threshold probability. Empirical average-rank Spearman is computed on the same generated rows.
key_unresolved_assumptions: A Gaussian copula describes continuous dependence throughout both threshold groups and the tails.
The single source threshold association is sufficient to calibrate this assumed copula family, but does not validate it.
Inflammation-related high ferritin with low Hb and other nonmonotone or subgroup relationships are not separately modeled.
The continuous association transports to the target; other copulas matching the same supplied evidence could yield different rank correlations.

limitations: This is an evidence-anchored scenario cohort, not an identified reconstruction of the target population or of individual measurements.
The source is a selected rural Chinese postpartum, parous, IUD-using cohort with specified health exclusions. The target differs substantially; no empirical transport function is available.
Hb scale, ferritin shape, copula family, and support bounds remain modeling assumptions. Matching the supplied summaries does not validate these choices.

The law has bounded positive concentrations and therefore finite moments of all orders. Bounds of Hb 3–20 g/dL and ferritin 0.1–5000 ug/L are broad pragmatic restrictions, not evidence-established absolute physiological limits; rarer extremes are excluded.

Ferritin has right-skewed, bounded lognormal-type tails. The chosen law does not separately model inflammation, liver disease, iron overload, treatment, or distinct anemia etiologies, despite the absence of a target CRP restriction.
The model is continuous and does not reproduce assay rounding or detection-limit ties. Average-rank handling remains appropriate if numerical ties occur.

Five thousand generated rows do not provide five thousand new pieces of biomedical evidence. Monte Carlo precision is distinct from source sampling uncertainty, structural uncertainty, and transport uncertainty; none is represented by an invented interval.
checks_actually_performed: Analytic estimand check: the transported cell law gives joint prevalence 173/1671 and crude odds ratio (173*1082)/(85*331), independently of the assumed marginal scales.

Analytic construction check: the ferritin mean-log equation accounts for both mixture components, and continuous monotone marginal transforms preserve the calibrated Gaussian-copula threshold probabilities and ranks.

Code inspection: output contains exactly row_id, hb_g_dl, ferritin_ug_l in order; row_id is unique integer; randomness uses the supplied seed; no output-table selection or realized-moment adjustment is included.

No code execution, numerical root verification, simulated-output checks, or empirical validation was performed in this construction call. Calibration-bracket checks are included in the executable generator but have not been run.
